mailArchive.title: Local mail archive
mailArchive.localOnly: Imported mail stays on this device, separate from server mailboxes. Reading, flags, moves and deletion never contact a provider. Moving archive mail to a remote mailbox is not supported. Archives remain after removing the original account.
mailArchive.searchScope: Search here covers only the selected local archive folder, including sender, recipients, subject and plain text. Regular mailbox search does not include archives.
mailArchive.limits: Up to 64 files / 512 MiB / 10,000 messages per operation. Each MIME message: 32 MiB; each body: 8 MiB; attachment: 20 MiB (24 MiB total decoded). Originals and attachments are stored transactionally. Identical MIME bytes are skipped across this account's local archives and folders. Message-ID is not used for deduplication.
mailArchive.confirmImport: Import into this local archive only? Nothing will be uploaded. Valid messages commit independently; failures and cancellation keep already imported messages. Re-import skips identical MIME bytes. Source files are never changed.
mailArchive.cancelled: Cancelled. Earlier committed messages / EML files remain. An incomplete MBOX export is not published.
mailArchive.empty: No archived messages in this folder match the search.
mailArchive.deleteWarning: Permanently delete this archived copy, its original MIME and attachments from the local archive? This cannot be undone. The server mailbox and original import files are not affected.
mailArchive.safePreview: Plain-text display only. HTML, remote images and embedded active content are never rendered here. Export preserves original imported MIME, including HTML and attachments.
mailArchive.noPlainBody: No plain-text body is available. Export the original MIME to view it in a trusted mail application.
mailArchive.mailboxNote: This exports email, not the settings backup. Only locally cached messages and attachments are exported; nothing is fetched from a provider. Missing attachments fail explicitly. Cached mail is reconstructed as MIME; imported archive EML is byte-for-byte original. Exports use private, atomic, non-overwriting files in your chosen directory. MBOX uses standard mboxrd escaping; a missing final newline is normalized.
